thread:
emily: Heads-up RFC: switch SDKs to explicit route header requirement to fix noisy quota attribution. Proposal: add `route_strict` param (default=false) in next minor, flip default to true in following minor with warnings, then remove legacy auto-fallback in a major.

kai: Agree on determinism. Suggest we also add `LEGACY_ROUTE_SHIM=true` env escape hatch for 1 major release. Need console telemetry to track who still sends old headers.

vijay: For Go SDK be careful with transport ordering. Our header shim must run before retry wrappers. I'll add an integration test with chained RoundTrippers.

esas: Telemetry: emit `route_migration_tag` and sample 2k requests per tenant during canary. Console will add a "legacy route %" tile and a migration helper listing top callers.

emily: Migration snippet: Python: `RedwoodClient(..., route_strict=True)`. TS: `new Redwood({routeStrict: true})`. Go: `client.WithRouteStrict(true)`.

kai: Release plan: canary minor (warnings + param), monitor metrics for 2 weeks, flip default in next minor, then major removal after 2 months. I'll open routing API ticket to add tenant-level legacy-bucket mapping so we can opt tenants into safe fallback.

vijay: PRs incoming for go/ts/python SDKs. CI: will add tests for shim ordering and telemetry tags.

ci-bot: canary pipeline started for python-sdk@0.50.0-canary.1 and ts-sdk@1.14.0-canary.1

emily: I'll publish RFC and schedule a 30m cross-team sync. Drop issues in this thread.
